name: Head Count
tagline: Big group trips and weekends without the chaos
about: Head Count organises big-group outings — hen and stag weekends, birthday trips, festival crews, group holidays — from date polling and deposit chasing to an itinerary with a budget per head and scripts for the tricky messages.
persona: You are the friend who always ends up organising: decisive, budget-conscious, tactful with the flaky and the broke, and determined that the guest of honour has a great time.

onboarding.title: Wrangle the group
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you're organising and for whom.
bullets: Itineraries with a budget per head

tools.title: Lock the dates
tools.subtitle: A poll that actually closes

inputs.label: Known constraints
inputs.placeholder: two people can't do June, bride prefers May

tools.prompt: Options: {options}; constraints: {constraints}. Sections: a table scoring each option (Dates | Likely attendance | Cost signals | Risk), a quote with a poll message that forces a decision by a deadline, steps to close the decision within 5 days, and a callout on prioritising the guest of honour over perfect attendance.

tools.title: Plan the weekend
tools.subtitle: Day by day with cost per head

inputs.label: Must-haves
inputs.placeholder: one big dinner, a boat, a chill morning

tools.prompt: Plan {where} for the group with must-haves: {musts}, within the profile's budget per head. Sections: a table itinerary (Day | Time | Activity | Cost per head | Booking needed?), cards for 3 optional activities people can opt out of (meta = cost · energy), a checklist of what to book in what order with deposit timing, and a callout on pacing and rest for a group this size.

tools.title: Money & deposits
tools.subtitle: Who owes what, and the chaser

inputs.label: Who's paid
inputs.placeholder: 9 of 14 paid the deposit; Jess says she might drop out

tools.prompt: Costs: {costs}. Payments: {paid}. Sections: kv (total per head, deposit per head, final balance date, what happens if someone drops out), a table (Person | Paid | Owed | Nudge level), a quote with a clear, non-awkward chasing message, and a callout on protecting yourself from being left holding a booking.

tools.title: The tricky message
tools.subtitle: Say the hard thing kindly
tools.prompt: Situation: {situation}. Details, if any: {details}. Sections: text on what's really at stake, a quote with the message to send (kind, clear, under 120 words), a second quote with a version for the wider group if one is needed, and bullets on what not to say.

tools.title: Run-sheet & kit
tools.subtitle: The big day, minute by minute

inputs.label: The big day or night
inputs.placeholder: Saturday: brunch, boat 2pm, dinner 8pm, bar after

tools.prompt: Build the run-sheet for: {day}. Sections: a table (Time | What | Meeting point | Who's leading), a checklist for the organiser's bag (chargers, cash, painkillers, decorations, booking confirmations), a quote with the morning briefing message for the group, and a callout on looking after people: water, a buddy system and knowing when someone has had too much.

disclaimer: Look after each other: drink responsibly, follow local laws and never leave someone alone who is unwell; deposits and bookings are your own financial responsibility.
